INTERLOPER-LOSE_CHAINS_RELIC.description: The first time you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card each turn, gain 2 [gold]Void Reach[/gold].
INTERLOPER-LOSE_CHAINS_RELIC.flavor: Each leap is a progress towards my desired end... yet the abyss pushes back.
INTERLOPER-LOSE_CHAINS_RELIC.title: Lose Chains
INTERLOPER-DARK_CHAINS_RELIC.description: The first time you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card each combat, gain 2 [gold]Void Reach[/gold].
INTERLOPER-DARK_CHAINS_RELIC.flavor: I can move, go around. Not freely though, no, it toys with me. It knows i know.
INTERLOPER-DARK_CHAINS_RELIC.title: Dark Chains
INTERLOPER-QUARK_WORM_RELIC.description: Whenever you consume 20 [color=#952990]Abyssal Corruption[/color], a random [gold]Power[/gold] card in your deck costs 1 less to play.
INTERLOPER-QUARK_WORM_RELIC.flavor: Weird.. You'd think such an esteemed Patreon would keep it's domain clean, oh the possibilities.
INTERLOPER-QUARK_WORM_RELIC.title: Quark Worm
INTERLOPER-ENTANGLED_LETTER_RELIC.descri: The first card you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] exhaust each combat is upgraded.
INTERLOPER-ENTANGLED_LETTER_RELIC.flavor: One half of the letter knows, the other half remembers.
INTERLOPER-ENTANGLED_LETTER_RELIC.title: Entangled Letter
INTERLOPER-CURSED_CLAW_RELIC.description: After killing an enemy with a card that consumed [color=#952990]Abyssal Corruption[/color], all other enemies gain 1 [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
INTERLOPER-CURSED_CLAW_RELIC.flavor: Eons... Picoseconds... can't describe the value of 'one moment'. when will mine be.
INTERLOPER-CURSED_CLAW_RELIC.title: Cursed Claw
INTERLOPER-OLD_INSCRIPTIONS_RELIC.descri: Whenever you clear [color=#541191]Dark Potential[/color], gain an extra effect based on the level reached: level 1 applies 1 [gold]Weak[/gold] to a random enemy without Weak, level 2 heals 1, level 3+ applies [color=#952990]Abyssal Corruption[/color] to ALL enemies.
INTERLOPER-OLD_INSCRIPTIONS_RELIC.flavor: My shackler can't.. or does not bother.. to write. Have i written this? must be. Is it a warning? A tip? Sure.
INTERLOPER-OLD_INSCRIPTIONS_RELIC.title: Old Inscriptions
INTERLOPER-GREATEST_GLYPH_RELIC.descript: When 50+ [color=#952990]Abyssal Corruption[/color] is present in combat, clearing [color=#541191]Dark Potential[/color] consumes half of all [color=#952990]Abyssal Corruption[/color] on enemies.
INTERLOPER-GREATEST_GLYPH_RELIC.title: Greatest Glyph
INTERLOPER-POCKET_POCKET_DIMENSION_RELIC: Cards with [gold]Ethereal[/gold] cannot be brought back from your [gold]Exhaust[/gold] pile.
Even the one who shackled me can't assert control over there.
INTERLOPER-FAMILY_PICTURE_RELIC.descript: Each turn, the first time you play a from a different character, gain 1 [color=#AE30A8]Void Reach[/color].
INTERLOPER-FAMILY_PICTURE_RELIC.flavor: Do i know them? They seem familiar... That could've been me.. It isn't though, is it? i could have been all of them. Or none.
INTERLOPER-FAMILY_PICTURE_RELIC.title: Family Picture
